program.name: Balance & Core Yoga
program.subject: Yoga
program.blurb: Steady and strong: standing balances one day, yoga core work the next.
program.about: Yoga for steadiness and strength. One day is standing balances: tree, warrior three, half moon and dancer. The other is core work: boat, plank, side plank and dolphin. Both start with sun salutations and end lying down. Level II brings harder poses and Level III holds every pose longer.
